title: Store Customization
description: Learn how to customize your store's appearance, branding, and layout to match your brand identity.
content:
Store Customization

Customize your store's appearance, branding, and layout to create a unique shopping experience that reflects your brand.

Branding

Set up your store's brand identity:

  • Logo: Upload your store logo (recommended: 200x80px)
  • Favicon: Add a custom favicon for browser tabs
  • Store Name: Display name on your storefront
  • Tagline: Short description or slogan

Color Scheme

Customize your store's color palette:

  • Primary color (main brand color)
  • Secondary color
  • Accent color
  • Text colors
  • Background colors

Colors affect buttons, links, headers, and other UI elements throughout your store.

Typography

Choose fonts for your store:

  • Heading font
  • Body text font
  • Font sizes
  • Line spacing

Layout Settings

Configure your store layout:

  • Header style (sticky, transparent, etc.)
  • Footer configuration
  • Sidebar settings
  • Product grid layout
  • Product page layout

Theme Customization

Most themes offer customization options through:

  • Theme settings panel
  • Custom CSS (for advanced users)
  • Widget areas
  • Template customization

Homepage Sections

Customize homepage sections:

  • Hero/banner section
  • Featured products
  • Categories showcase
  • Testimonials
  • Newsletter signup
  • Footer content

Saving Changes

Always preview your changes before publishing. Use the Preview button to see how changes look on your storefront.

Best Practices

  • Maintain consistent branding across all pages
  • Use high-quality images for logos and banners
  • Ensure good contrast for readability
  • Test your store on mobile devices
  • Keep customization minimal for better performance

meta_description: Guide to customizing your store's branding, colors, typography, layout, and appearance to match your brand identity.
